title: Very Hot Day
hook: 天太热水坑都晒干了，爸爸打起戏水池，还买了冰淇淋，乔治的恐龙冰棍却掉在地上。

cells.a: The sun is shining and it is a very hot day.

cells.q: Why can't they jump in the puddles?
cells.a: Because the puddles are all dry in the hot sun.
cells.cn: 因为太阳把水坑都晒干了。

cells.a: He is pumping up the paddling pool for the children.
cells.cn: 他在给孩子们的戏水池打气。

cells.q: Do the children like the little pool?
cells.a: Yes, Peppa and George love their paddling pool.
cells.cn: 喜欢，佩奇和乔治最爱他们的戏水池。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask Ms. Rabbit for?
cells.a: She asked if she and George can have an ice cream.
cells.cn: 她问她和乔治能不能买冰淇淋。

cells.a: She asked the ice cream lady for a cone.
cells.cn: 她向卖冰淇淋的兔小姐要了一个蛋筒。

cells.q: What did Ms. Rabbit have for George?
cells.a: She had a dinosaur shaped ice-lolly for him.
cells.cn: 她正好有一根恐龙形状的冰棍。

cells.a: It melted and fell on the ground, so George is sad.
cells.cn: 冰棍化了掉在地上，乔治很难过。

cells.q: What do they find at the end?
cells.a: The puddles are back, so they put their boots on.
cells.cn: 水坑又出现了，他们赶紧穿上靴子。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: hot, sun, puddle, pool, ice cream, lolly
helper.actions: shine, jump, pump, swim, buy, melt

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Very Hot Day”.
ending: In the end, the puddles are back again. My favourite part is ______.
